stories.headline: Judge orders White House to restore CNN, MS NOW, and Politico access
stories.summary: U.S. District Judge Timothy Kelly ordered early Thursday that the White House immediately restore hard-pass access for CNN, MS NOW, and Politico, granting a 14-day temporary restraining order after finding the outlets were likely revoked without due process. Kelly — a Trump first-term nominee — rejected the administration’s national-security justification, noting Trump’s Truth Social ban focused on “fake news” and negativity, not security. The outlets’ lawyer called it a strong ruling for press freedom; the White House did not immediately comment, and Trump had already signaled an appeal.

stories.headline: Trumbull cemetery lands on new CT Haunted History Trail map
stories.summary: Gov. Ned Lamont’s office launched the Connecticut Haunted History Trail, a statewide tourism map of more than 130 haunted landmarks, cemeteries, witch-trial sites, and paranormal attractions — including Gregory’s Four Corners Burial Grounds in Trumbull, home of the Hannah Cranna “Wicked Witch of Monroe” grave. The free interactive map at CTvisit.com spans nine categories and builds on earlier Pizza, Christmas Movie, and Oyster trails. Officials frame it as history-plus-tourism ahead of Halloween travel season.

stories.headline: Trump and Xi sit down in Washington with trade truce extended, hard issues open
stories.summary: Presidents Trump and Xi Jinping enter Thursday’s White House summit after greeting each other planeside Wednesday and agreeing to extend the Busan trade truce to January 10. AP notes both leaders still believe time favors their side while Iran leverage, Taiwan arms sales, advanced-chip controls, and an AI-incident notification idea remain unresolved. Trump is leaning into pomp — South Lawn helipad ready, tech CEOs on the state-dinner guest list — even as analysts expect small gains and conflict avoidance rather than a breakthrough.

stories.headline: ICE-shot Austin delivery driver needs spine surgery; agent reportedly had no body cam
stories.summary: Rep. Greg Casar said Wednesday that Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, the Venezuelan DoorDash driver shot by ICE in Austin, needs surgery to remove a bullet lodged near his spine and remains in detention with limited pain care. Separate reports said the recent ICE recruit who fired had been issued a body camera but was not wearing it; another officer’s cam did not capture the shooting. DHS still frames the stop as a dangerous evasion attempt, while attorneys seek to block deportation ahead of a Sept. 30 hearing.

stories.headline: Apple testing iOS 27.0.1 after iPhone 18 Pro Face ID complaints
stories.summary: Days after shipping iOS 27, Apple is already testing iOS 27.0.1 for iPhones, MacRumors logs show — typically a bug-fix and security patch wave. Some iPhone 18 Pro owners have reported Face ID problems, making that a likely target. watchOS 27.0.1 is already out for Series 12 and Ultra 4 and fixes unexpected restarts; a public iOS 27.0.1 drop is expected in the next few days or weeks.

stories.headline: Meta’s Connect ‘one more thing’: Muse Charm AI Tamagotchi puck
stories.summary: Mark Zuckerberg closed Meta Connect by unveiling Muse Charm — a keychain-sized puck with a fingerprint sensor and a Tamagotchi-like avatar for chatting with Muse AI without unlocking a phone. Meta aims for holiday availability while also announcing lighter tethered Meta VR Glasses ($1,300, spring), audio-only Ray-Ban glasses from $349 shipping Oct. 13, and refreshed camera Ray-Bans from $449. The gadget lane lands as Apple has reportedly shelved its own AI pendant plans.

stories.headline: Penguins preseason lineup vs Columbus features both Ruck twins
stories.summary: Pittsburgh listed its Thursday preseason lineup for Columbus at Nationwide Arena (7:00 PM ET on 105.9 The X), putting Liam Ruck and Markus Ruck on the same forward group after their joint debut buzz. The deep prospect/AHL mix also includes Rutger McGroarty, Ville Koivunen, Elmer Soderblom, and goalies Sergei Murashov and Collin Delia. The game is the next look after Wednesday’s wave of roster cuts ahead of the 2026-27 open.

stories.headline: Jets Week 3 injury report: Fitzpatrick, Mauigoa, Taylor miss Wednesday practice
stories.summary: Heading into Sunday’s Motor City reunion at Detroit, the Jets listed safeties Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin), linebacker Kiko Mauigoa (quad), running back Kene Nwangwu (back), and tight end Mason Taylor (thumb) as Wednesday DNPs. Edge Joseph Ossai was limited with a foot injury while David Bailey practiced fully despite an elbow issue. Detroit also showed several limited or out starters on the first midweek report of Week 3.

stories.headline: Candace Owens challenges Erika Kirk footage metadata — demands on-record answer
stories.summary: Candace Owens reignited her clash with Andrew Wilson over family footage tied to Charlie Kirk’s final hours, arguing iPhone metadata can be edited and does not alone prove authenticity. She called public sharing of private moments with Kirk’s children “deeply disturbing” and said a simple on-record statement from Erika Kirk would settle who recorded the clip. Owens also needled Wilson to focus on Tyler Robinson’s aggravated-murder charges instead of the video fight.

stories.headline: Fall color map: early yellows in northern New England and Great Lakes
stories.summary: WeatherBug’s Sept. 22 foliage update says fall has “entered the chat” but most of the Lower 48 is still green. Beginning color is concentrated in northern Maine, pockets of Vermont/New Hampshire/upstate New York, the western Great Lakes near Lake Superior, and high Rockies/Southwest elevations. Southern New England including Connecticut remains predominantly green; the outlet will refresh the national map each Tuesday through peak season.

stories.headline: Tesla Semi factory ‘Rollout’ lands today in Sparks — ceremonial opening after April production
stories.summary: Tesla’s invite-only Semi Rollout is set for Sept. 24 at the dedicated 1.7-million-square-foot Semi plant beside Gigafactory Nevada in Sparks — a ribbon-cutting months after high-volume production began in April. The plant is aimed at 50,000 Class 8 trucks a year with Standard (325-mile) and Long Range (500-mile) variants, Megacharger support, and factory tours plus Semi ride-alongs for RSVP’d guests 21+. Analysts still peg 2026 deliveries well below nameplate capacity as the ramp continues.

stories.headline: LEGO Harry Potter Ministry of Magic Collectors’ Edition: 3,491 pieces, $449.99
stories.summary: Marking 25 years since Philosopher’s Stone, LEGO unveiled Harry Potter The Ministry of Magic – Collectors’ Edition (76476): a 3,491-piece cross-section with street-level phone booth, Umbridge and Arthur Weasley offices, courtroom, Hall of Prophecy, 14 minifigures, and Kingsley Shacklebolt’s Lynx Patronus. Insiders early access began Aug. 29; general release Sept. 1 at $449.99, with a phone-booth GWP for early Insiders buyers. It joins September’s busy adult-display wave already stocking shelves.
